title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Not sure if it's really me standing before you? Here's a hint: the Gemini doesn't talk.

title: Talk 1
original: Multitasking has never been a problem for me.

title: Talk 3
original: You need to clean your pot regularly, if you want decent coffee.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Seeing is not always believing. Technology reveals the hidden truth.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I've encountered a few difficulties because of my appearance. No more than that, though.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I wonder what souvenirs I'll take home from this unforgettable journey.

title: Idle
original: Hold on, I'll be right back.

title: Onboard
original: Code name Iana, Team Rainbow. There's a lot of intel we can share with each other.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Do I get more access permissions?

title: Promotion 2
original: Here's hoping this helps me reach more unexplored corners.

title: Added to Squad
original: Friendly reminder, my hologram doesn't stop bullets.

title: Depart
original: Rage against the dying of the light.

title: 4-star Result
original: All systems are complementary, if you know how to connect them.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: You've still got fight in you, show them what you're made of.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: If that's how you want it.
